job: Negotiating multi-year take-or-pay HBM allocation and translating the resulting supply ceiling into shippable-accelerator capacity guidance for investors.
outcome: An accelerator vendor or hyperscaler names HBM allocation as a stated gating limit on its shipment or AI-capacity ramp.
motivation: When a rival locks scarce memory supply, conceding or disclosing the capacity ceiling first sets the procurement narrative.

task.what: tie HBM contract allocation to a stated shipment-ceiling guidance figure
task.where: earnings calls, guidance documents, capacity-roadmap disclosures
task.when: today through Q2 2027 runway, ahead of upcoming quarterly prints
task.why: answer a rival's locked supply or concede a capacity floor
task.how: take-or-pay HBM contracts plus internal accelerator-yield models

job: Pre-committing scarce HBM4/HBM3E output years out under take-or-pay Strategic Customer Agreements, hard-allocating supply across competing accelerator buyers.
outcome: Pre-committed, structurally short HBM supply forces buyers to disclose allocation as the binding constraint on their accelerator output.
motivation: Lock minimum contracted revenue and upfront cash while demand exceeds half-to-two-thirds fillable supply across the cycle.

task.what: sign take-or-pay agreements hard-allocating sold-out HBM output
task.where: Strategic Customer Agreements with accelerator and hyperscaler buyers
task.when: today through Q2 2027 runway, as multi-year capacity is committed
task.why: secure minimum revenue while supply stays structurally short
